items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee only responds to the interviewer's mention of Bob Yutak with 'The building he built.' There is no direct interaction or personal relationship described between Juan Tizol and Bob Yutak in the transcript.

ctx.x: Well, anyway, he told me to order dinner, but evidently I didn't order dinner, as Juan said; we came home afterwards, because different ones began to come in. I tell you who came in -- what was that guy's name who is in the swimming pool business?
Bob Yutak and his wife came in, and we didn't stay very long afterwards; we came home.
